editorial.blurb: A bright, nostalgic café downtown serving thoughtfully crafted breakfast sandwiches, pastries, and specialty lattes that justify the occasional splurge.
editorial.insiderTip: Sign up for the app to snag a $10 discount on your first order, and arrive Monday mornings when it's less busy—or order ahead if you're coming during peak times.
